hypothesis: A converged conditional posterior is not necessarily a correct model; compare loss-motivated mean/median decisions against KNOWN artificial latent flows under matched and misspecified assumptions.
relative_L1_median: Coordinate weighted median with posterior sample weights1/sum(flow), motivated by UNCLIPPED relativeL1; not claimed optimal for clipped/composite score.
matched_control: Generate supplied b first; draw latent f* from independent nonnegative Gaussian centered at b, then c=A*f*. Only factor1 exactly matches assumed posterior. Counterexamples draw sparse/structured f* first and corrupt b with wrong noise.
convergence_gate: Every path and global diagnostics raw split-Rhat<1.05, approximate ESS>=100. Posterior method scores are withheld if gate fails; paired comparisons only share eligible cases and failure rates are reported.
selection: No method/assumption selection on artificial scores. All seven actions and all failure cases retained. This is not real OD validation.
scope: Controlled small synthetic networks only; matched-case wins are calibration checks, not independent evidence for real traffic. Official Task4 baseline unchanged, no Kaggle upload.
